senses.gloss: परोक्त (˚रा-उक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. contradicted.
परोच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be contradicted.

परोक्ष परो-ऽक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. परस् +
४. अक्ष, opposed to प्रत्य्-अक्ष, q. v.), beyond
the range of sight, out of sight, invisible, imper-
ceptible, escaping observation; unknown, strange,
[]
unintelligible; absent, past; (अस्), m. an ascetic,
religious hermit; N. of one of the sons of Anu; (आ),
f. past or completed action (in grammar perhaps
with वृत्ति); (अम्), n. invisibility, absence, secrecy;
(in grammar) past time or tense. The acc., inst.,
abl., and loc. cases of परोक्ष are used adverbially,
as follow: (अम्), ind. out of sight, behind one's
back, in the absence of, without the knowledge of
(in the earlier language with inst., in the later with
gen.); surreptitiously; (एण), ind., Ved. out of
sight, secretly, mysteriously, surreptitiously; (आत्),
ind., Ved. secretly, without the knowledge of (with
inst.); (ए), ind. behind one's back, in the absence
of, imperceptibly, surreptitiously; [cf. अ-परोक्ष.]
—परोक्ष-कृता, f., Ved., scil. ऋक्, a hymn or
verse in which a deity is spoken of in the third
person, the first person being kept out of sight
(e. g. ‘Indra rules over heaven and earth,’ &c.).
—प-
रोक्ष-जित्, त्, त्, त्, conquering invisibly, an unseen
conqueror.
—परोक्ष-ता, f. or परोक्ष-त्व, अम्,
n. the being beyond the sphere of observation, ob-
scurity, invisibility, imperceptibility; keeping one's
self as the first person out of sight, speaking of one's
self in the third person (Ved.).
—परोक्ष-भोग,
अस्, m. enjoyment or possession of anything in the
absence of the proprietor.
—परोक्ष-मन्मथ,
अस्, आ, अम्, inexperienced in love, a stranger to love.
—परोक्ष-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, whose life is unseen,
living out of sight; formed out of sight or unseen,
formed in obscurity; (इस्), f. an unseen life.
—प-
रोक्षार्थ (˚ष-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having an
unseen meaning, secret, recondite; (अम्), n. an
absent or invisible object.

पारोक्ष पारोक्ष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. परोक्ष),
undiscernible, unintelligible, obscure, mysterious.

परो-गव्यूति, ind. (fr. परस् + ग्˚), Ved. beyond
or outside the pasture land; (Sāy.) = क्रोश-द्वयाद्
देशात् परस्तात्, further than a Gavyūti, q. v.

परो-बाहु, ind. (fr. परस् + ब्˚), Ved. beyond
the arm or reach.

परो-मात्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. परस् + म्˚), Ved.
immense, huge, vast.

परो-लक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. परस् + ल्˚), over a
lakh, more than 100, 000.

परो-ऽवरम् (fr. परस् + अव्˚), ind., Ved. from
top to bottom; from hand to hand; in succession,
one after another.

परो-ऽवरीण, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. परस् + अव्˚), having
both superior and inferior, prior and subsequent, &c.

परो-वरीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (fr. परस् + व्˚), Ved.
broader on the outside or at the top; better than
good, most excellent of all; (अस्), n. the highest
happiness.

परोष्णिह् (fr. परस् + उष्˚), क्, f. a kind of
metre (consisting of 8 + 8 + 12 syllables).

परोष्णी परोष्णी, f. a cockroach, (some-
times wrongly written परोष्टी); N. of a river.

पारोक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, undiscernible, invisible,
hidden; (अम्), n. mysteriousness, mystery.

पारोवर्य पारोवर्य, अम्, n. (fr. परो-ऽव-
रम्), tradition.
